scope: Source review plus live small clock tail/heartbeat, no full API scan, native call or source modification. Window was selected as the current final500 text lines, not a preregistered unbiased performance sample.
heartbeat_scope: Delivered facts give only lower-bound completions; submitted bridges are not independently verified received bridges.

heartbeat.progress_scope: Public delivered completion receipts are a lower bound until final offline result. No diagnostic is supplied to the owner policy.

facts: Every post-startup10s tick invokes both owners, even while the token is loaded or absent. ProtocolClient.refresh already uses active-request indexes; do not claim repeated queries of every historical completed row.
Native026 protocol_planning_snapshots_v2 scans retained messages for newest per source but renders only the newest delivered body; it does NOT return the entire publication history.
Each immutable body includes every released source-owned waiting job contract, carried jobs, full source nodes and terminal/action coverage. These grow with the preserved full input denominator.

base.delivered_peer recomputes the full typed digest/coverage on every call. latest_own_capture scans the entire retained planning outbox, revalidates each past selfACK identity/time, then deeply copies the newest ACK and valid envelope.

Tape canonicalizes every returned object through dumps+loads, then json.dump streams another full encoding into gzip level1; it hashes the written file and appends manifest. Measured API envelopes include all of that, so the envelope is NOT isolated native runtime.

BridgeOwner also scans historical outbox and publication rows on each activation. Actual new publications are already event-like after frozen startup (ACK relay/current-empty invitation/peer reply); most live10s activations add no new snapshot.

Current input has owner_notifications enabled. Native sequence is monotone but change_mask resets at each differing logical timestamp, so polling only the final mask after advance_to(+10) cannot prove no intermediate planning delivery.

candidate_priority.candidate: Lossless serialize-once diagnostic tape, separate new harness only
candidate_priority.why: Keeps every existing API call, return object, policy schedule, raw evidence and full cost. Replace redundant result JSON roundtrip plus token-by-token json.dump with one whole-row exact JSON encoding and gzip write; retain error-path prefix/flush/hash and ordered replay.
candidate_priority.proof_needed: Exact canonical JSON-equivalent rows including tuple/list normalization, NaN rejection, error/shortwrite behavior; exact ordered API tape and final physical/controller/seal parity. All encoding/write costs remain measured.
candidate_priority.limit: May remove experiment artifact overhead, not production policy work or an original-business100ms certificate. Existing spool result is a reference, not proof this much larger-body workload improves.

candidate_priority.candidate: Immutable typed capture validation/derived selfcapture index
candidate_priority.why: Reuse validation only for same actually delivered identity+digest and immutable body; cache source schema/coverage result and latest selfACK selected revision, while current-time expiry/status/tombstone is checked afresh. Retain full histories and original ordering.
candidate_priority.proof_needed: Private immutable ownership/no aliased mutation; duplicate/reordered ACK revisions, expired newest tombstone, missing/rejected publications, restore/fork invalidation; do not use cached body as fresh local occupancy.
candidate_priority.limit: Does not remove current native render or raw tape encoding; body identity still must be established legally.

candidate_priority.candidate: Public notification-driven inbox invalidation at unchanged10s policy boundaries
candidate_priority.why: Use actual all-owner delivered notifications to establish whether any planning delivery happened since last complete cursor. Keep every original10s owner decision/retry deadline and expire cached envelope by now.
candidate_priority.proof_needed: No latest-mask-only shortcut. Either unchanged complete sequence (conservative; many job events defeat it), or advance_until_owner_notification across every complete timestamp, accumulate128 notifications until original boundary; gaps/incomplete/unknown/fork/restore force actual full endpoint. Reconstruct dynamic read_at/status from public time only if exact renderer semantics are proven.
candidate_priority.limit: Additional notification calls may cost more; same-timestamp and physical parity must be checked. No next-private-event access, no deletion of raw history, no claim existing policy is unchanged without exact comparison.

not_recommended_without_new_policy_study: Do not merely stretch PERIOD or suppress owner current-empty invitation: may alter actual handoff, FIFO availability and capture freshness.
Do not skip remote inbox solely because token is absent: peer empty invitation may require the local reply to progress.
Do not skip loaded-phase inbox based only on intended token location: public tray/current completion transition evidence and reply/ACK obligations must be preserved.
Do not omit mandatory native/tape/validation cost, change input/permissions or extend the live2400s cap.
